description: This file defines the Migration class used for database migration tasks within the vtiger CRM project, including methods for setting parameters, taking database dumps, dropping and creating databases, applying dumps, and modifying database schemas during migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents the database migration operations including dump, drop, create, apply data, modify database, and migrating between versions.

methods.name: Migration
methods.description: Constructor initializing migration with old and new database connection objects.

methods.name: setOldDatabaseParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the old database connection.

methods.name: setNewDatabaseParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the new database connection.

methods.name: takeDatabaseDump
methods.description: Creates a dump of the specified database and returns the dump filename.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database with the given name.

methods.name: applyDumpData
methods.description: Applies a dump file to a specified database.

methods.name: localGetTabID
methods.description: Retrieves the tabid for a specified module.

methods.name: getTablesCountInNewDatabase
methods.description: Returns the number of tables in the new database.

methods.name: getTablesCountInOldDatabase
methods.description: Returns the number of tables in the old database.

methods.name: modifyDatabase
methods.description: Executes schema modification queries for database version updates.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Coordinates the entire migration process, including dump, drop, create, apply, and modify steps based on user options.
